title: Terrain Following and Collision Avoidance Intern
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role We are developing advanced autonomous systems that need to fly close to the ground, over varied terrain and through cluttered environments such as forests and built-up areas, where there is very little margin for error. Even a carefully prepared flight plan must be backed by onboard sensing, ready to react to terrain variations and unexpected obstacles. We are building this capability and exploring hybrid approaches that combine planning and real-time reaction. Your mission The goal of this internship is to explore, develop and evaluate terrain-following and collision-avoidance methods based primarily on onboard sensors, enabling safe low-altitude flight. Responsibilities Literature review : Conduct a comprehensive review of existing terrain-following approaches and obstacle-avoidance Algorithm Implementation : Develop and implement various algorithms based on the literature review and project requirements using simulated and real-world flight data. Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance, safety margins and computational overhead of the developed algorithms. Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware. Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results, and conclusions. Flight Tests Participation : Actively participate in flight test sessions to gather real-world data and validate the effectiveness of the developed algorithms in operational conditions. Contribute to real-time deployment. Candidates Requirements Educational Background: A strong academic record in robotics, aerospace engineering, automatic control, applied mathematics or a related field. Knowledge of perception, guidance or motion planning is a strong plus. Technical Skills: Solid foundation in sensor fusion and/or guidance and control. Experience with lidar or vision processing, terrain data or drones is a major plus. Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous and able to take initiative.
